items.title: Crypto platform Bitget suspects North Korea is responsible for $352 million hack
items.summary: Crypto exchange Bitget suspects North Korean hackers may be behind a security breach that affected about $351.6 million in digital assets, citing preliminary evidence from an ongoing investigation.

items.title: China's Xi urges U.S. to cooperate on AI
items.summary: BEIJING — Chinese President Xi Jinping told U.S. President Donald Trump that there is more opportunity for cooperation than competition on artificial intelligence.

items.title: Here's who attended the Trump-Xi state dinner
items.summary: U.S. government officials, business leaders and their spouses dominated a list of more than 100 people who will attend a state dinner Thursday, according to a White House press release.

items.title: Philadelphia Fed's Anna Paulson says 'modest' rate moves likely ahead to tame inflation
items.summary: Philadelphia Federal Reserve President Anna Paulson said Thursday that she and her colleagues may need to raise interest rates further to bring inflation back to target.

items.title: China confirms first AI talks with U.S. have taken place, hints at trade truce extension
items.summary: BEIJING—China's Commerce Ministry confirmed Thursday that its senior trade negotiators had held their first talks with the U.S. on artificial intelligence.

items.title: China saw 'surprise' jump in U.S. orders ahead of Trump-Xi summit, private survey shows
items.summary: American businesses ramped up orders for Chinese goods in the weeks leading up to the high-stakes summit this week, as companies positioned for continued stability between the world's two largest economies.

items.title: Surging Treasury yields pose a brand new problem for Kevin Warsh and the Fed
items.summary: The bond market is yelling at the Federal Reserve, but the messages are coming from different directions and pose a dilemma for policymakers as they seek to strike a balance that won't tank the economy.

items.title: Here's what happens to the economy when Treasury yields soar like they are now
items.summary: Soaring Treasury yields aren't just bad for the government and its $40 trillion debt.
